title: SEVEN: DADO's premium porcelain stoneware brand
excerpt: Black marble, golden veining and large formats: SEVEN collections are now in the DADO showroom.
body:
SEVEN is DADO's brand for the premium segment. Its collections bring black marble, gold-veined stone and graphite surfaces in 600×1200 and 800×1600 formats.

The signature tile is Portoro Oro: golden veins on a deep black ground. Beside it sit the classic Nero Marquina, the expressive Grand Antique and the calm Pietra Grafite.

All collections are on display at the DADO showroom in Tashkent, where our specialists are glad to advise.
